dialogues.jp: （今…………何時だろうな）
dialogues.en: "(What time is it now...?)"
dialogues.text: "(What time is it now...?)"

dialogues.jp:
電話を切る間際、たしかに待ち合わせの時間を
聴いた筈ではあるのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Just as the line was cut yesterday, I wanted to ask what
time to met...
dialogues.text:
Just as the line was cut yesterday, I wanted to ask what
time to met...

dialogues.jp: まるで覚えていなかった。
dialogues.en: But I couldn't get it through.
dialogues.text: But I couldn't get it through.

dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、舞い上がってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Maybe she meant a lot later...?"
dialogues.text: "Maybe she meant a lot later...?"

dialogues.jp:
これから工藤に会えると思うだけで嬉しいのは
確かだ。
dialogues.en:
I felt a tiny bit of happiness that I could meet Kudou
again.
dialogues.text:
I felt a tiny bit of happiness that I could meet Kudou
again.

dialogues.jp: だけど……。
dialogues.en: Yet...
dialogues.text: Yet...

dialogues.jp:
それ以上に『彼女』の困ったような声が耳から
離れなかった。
dialogues.en:
I can't forget the sad tone of "her" voice before she hung
up.
dialogues.text:
I can't forget the sad tone of "her" voice before she hung
up.

dialogues.jp: 「一体、何を話してくれるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Just what is she going to tell me?"
dialogues.text: "Just what is she going to tell me?"

dialogues.jp:
ベンチに座る俺の肩にはすでに花弁が層となり
降り積もっている。
dialogues.en:
I sat on my bench with arms outstretched on it, a layer of
flower petals slowly enveloping them.
dialogues.text:
I sat on my bench with arms outstretched on it, a layer of
flower petals slowly enveloping them.

dialogues.jp: 「はは、なんかフラレ男みたいだな……」
dialogues.en: "Haha, I look like a guy who just got rejected..."
dialogues.text: "Haha, I look like a guy who just got rejected..."

dialogues.jp:
数分ごとに視線をあげ、きょろきょろと見慣れ
た制服姿を探す。
dialogues.en:
I looked around countless times, trying to find the familiar
school uniform.
dialogues.text:
I looked around countless times, trying to find the familiar
school uniform.

dialogues.jp: 工藤の姿はまだ見えなかった。
dialogues.en: But Kudou's figure never showed up.
dialogues.text: But Kudou's figure never showed up.

dialogues.jp: 「……誰をお探しですか」
dialogues.en: "...Who are you looking for?"
dialogues.text: "...Who are you looking for?"

dialogues.jp:
しっとりとした声が降って来て、ゆっくり振り
返った。
dialogues.en:
I turned my head towards the direction where the voice came
from.
dialogues.text:
I turned my head towards the direction where the voice came
from.

dialogues.jp:
そこには楚々とした和装の美少女がどこか恥ず
かしそうな微笑を浮かべながら立っていた。
dialogues.en:
Standing there, was a gentle-looking young girl, dressed in
a kimono, with a slightly embarassed smile.
dialogues.text:
Standing there, was a gentle-looking young girl, dressed in
a kimono, with a slightly embarassed smile.

dialogues.jp:
涼しげな柄の着物にショートの髪がよく似合っ
ている。
dialogues.en: The short-cut hair and kimono went very well together.
dialogues.text: The short-cut hair and kimono went very well together.

dialogues.jp: 「……分かりませんか、私のこと」
dialogues.en: "...You don't recognize me?"
dialogues.text: "...You don't recognize me?"

dialogues.jp:
八割方の確信を抱きつつも、俺の貧困な想像を
上回る『彼女』の姿に迂闊な返事ができない。
dialogues.en:
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't place this girl from
anywhere in my memories.
dialogues.text:
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't place this girl from
anywhere in my memories.

dialogues.jp:
ややあって彼女はにっこりと笑い、呆れたよう
な呟きを漏らした。
dialogues.en: Amazed, the girl let out a slight giggle and murmured.
dialogues.text: Amazed, the girl let out a slight giggle and murmured.

dialogues.jp:
「ったく、つくづくニブい奴だよな……朝倉っ
　てさ」
dialogues.en: "Sheesh, you're really really slow... you idiot, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Sheesh, you're really really slow... you idiot, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
それはよく聞きなれた、『あいつ』の口調だっ
た。
dialogues.en: Finally I recognized "that person"'s tone.
dialogues.text: Finally I recognized "that person"'s tone.

dialogues.en: "....You're Kudou!?"
dialogues.text: "....You're Kudou!?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「はい、正解」
dialogues.en: "Correct."
dialogues.text: "Correct."

dialogues.jp:
どこかはにかんだように……『彼女』は微笑ん
だ。
dialogues.en: Nowhere to run... she continued smiling at me.
dialogues.text: Nowhere to run... she continued smiling at me.

dialogues.jp:
工藤の家は代々続く名家で、ひとり娘に生まれ
た工藤、叶は厳しい道徳観念に基づいたしつけ
を施されてきたのだという。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's family spanned several generations. Being the only
child, she was grilled to perfection in morals and
behaviour.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's family spanned several generations. Being the only
child, she was grilled to perfection in morals and
behaviour.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「｛しんし／真摯｝な態度で勉学に臨むべき学生時代に色恋
　沙汰など以ての外。故に在学中は女で在る事
　を捨てなさいって……………………」
dialogues.en:
"To ensure that I would have no thoughts of illicit romance,
I was to conceal myself as a male in school..."
dialogues.text:
"To ensure that I would have no thoughts of illicit romance,
I was to conceal myself as a male in school..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……当主である祖母ちゃんが言いつけたわけ
　か」
dialogues.en:
"...And that's what the head of your family, your
grandmother, said?"
dialogues.text:
"...And that's what the head of your family, your
grandmother, said?"

dialogues.jp:
小説や漫画みたいな話だが、そんなこと現実に
在りうるものなのか。
dialogues.en:
It sounded more like a plot from some manga, but that was
the reality placed before me.
dialogues.text:
It sounded more like a plot from some manga, but that was
the reality placed before me.

dialogues.jp: 工藤はややうつむいて言葉を続けた。
dialogues.en: After a short pause, Kudou continued.
dialogues.text: After a short pause, Kudou continued.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「女であることが露見した場合は直ちに環境を
　変えろと――転校しろ、とも言われているん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"The times where my true identity as a female was
discovered, I was immediately transferred into a different
school."
dialogues.text:
"The times where my true identity as a female was
discovered, I was immediately transferred into a different
school."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「そんな……お前の気持ちはいっさいお構いな
　しなのか！」
dialogues.en: "That's crazy! What about your own feelings!?"
dialogues.text: "That's crazy! What about your own feelings!?"

dialogues.jp: 静かに頷く工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou quietly nodded.
dialogues.text: Kudou quietly nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「当主の言いつけには……逆らえませんから」
dialogues.en: "The head of the family's orders... cannot be opposed."
dialogues.text: "The head of the family's orders... cannot be opposed."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「しきたりだかなんだか知らないけど、随分と
　理不尽な話だな……なんか釈然としない」
dialogues.en:
"Customs or discpline or whatever, that's completely
unreasonable... I'm not satisfied with that outcome at all."
dialogues.text:
"Customs or discpline or whatever, that's completely
unreasonable... I'm not satisfied with that outcome at all."

dialogues.jp:
あ、お前の祖母ちゃんを悪く言ってるわけじゃ
ないぞと付け加える。
dialogues.en:
Ah, I'm not trying to make your grandmother out to be some
horrible person though...
dialogues.text:
Ah, I'm not trying to make your grandmother out to be some
horrible person though...

dialogues.jp:
俺のその言葉に、工藤は何故だか少し頬を染め
ながら微笑した。
dialogues.en:
A little smile began to grow on Kudou's cheeks from my
words.
dialogues.text:
A little smile began to grow on Kudou's cheeks from my
words.

dialogues.speaker: Kanae
dialogues.jp:
「お願いします…………私はいまの風見学園か
　ら、いまのクラスから離れたくないんです」
dialogues.en:
"Please... I don't want to be taken away from my class, or
Kazami Academy."
dialogues.text:
"Please... I don't want to be taken away from my class, or
Kazami Academy."

dialogues.jp: 切実な瞳で訴える。
dialogues.en: She stared at me, her eyes pleading.
dialogues.text: She stared at me, her eyes pleading.

dialogues.speaker: Kanae
dialogues.jp:
「どうかこのことは私と朝倉君だけの秘密に
　……」
dialogues.en: "So please, keep my secret... between you and me..."
dialogues.text: "So please, keep my secret... between you and me..."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はそう言ってベンチの上に平伏する。俺は
慌てて彼女を制した。
dialogues.en: Kudou bowed so deeply, I couldn't bear to watch it.
dialogues.text: Kudou bowed so deeply, I couldn't bear to watch it.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、よせよ、顔を上げてくれよ」
dialogues.en: "D, don't do that, lift your head."
dialogues.text: "D, don't do that, lift your head."

dialogues.jp:
ああ……参ったな。そんな事されたら俺が困っ
てしまう。
dialogues.en: Haah, I'm doomed. I can't win against something like that.
dialogues.text: Haah, I'm doomed. I can't win against something like that.

dialogues.jp: この子に哀しい思いなんかさせたくないと思う。
dialogues.en: This girl, and such a sad story...
dialogues.text: This girl, and such a sad story...

dialogues.jp:
「……工藤がそう望むなら、クラスの奴らにば
　れないよう守ってやるから」
dialogues.en:
"...If that's your wish, I'd make sure no one else finds
out."
dialogues.text:
"...If that's your wish, I'd make sure no one else finds
out."

dialogues.jp:
こほんと咳を一つしてから、俺は工藤にそう言っ
た。
dialogues.en: After a quick cough, I gave her my word.
dialogues.text: After a quick cough, I gave her my word.

dialogues.jp: 驚いたように顔を上げる工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou lifted his head, slightly surprised.
dialogues.text: Kudou lifted his head, slightly surprised.

dialogues.jp:
「俺だって、お前がいなくなると困る。杉並の
　相手は、俺だけの手に負えないしな」
dialogues.en:
"It'd be bad for me if you left as well. I can't take
Suginami's crap by myself."
dialogues.text:
"It'd be bad for me if you left as well. I can't take
Suginami's crap by myself."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は暫しの間俺を見つめていたが――やがて
とても綺麗な笑顔を見せた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou peered at me for awhile... then a beautiful smile grew
on her face.
dialogues.text:
Kudou peered at me for awhile... then a beautiful smile grew
on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう……朝倉君……」
dialogues.en: "Thank you... Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you... Asakura..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: （……うわっ、か、かわいい）
dialogues.en: "(...Gwah, so cute.)"
dialogues.text: "(...Gwah, so cute.)"

dialogues.jp:
それだけで心臓が早鐘を打つ……。頬がかっと
染まった。
dialogues.en:
Alarm bells were ringing in my heart... my cheeks started to
flare.
dialogues.text:
Alarm bells were ringing in my heart... my cheeks started to
flare.

dialogues.jp:
「それに……工藤と二人だけの秘密を持つのも
　悪くないし……」
dialogues.en: "And... it'd be nice for the two of us to share a secret..."
dialogues.text: "And... it'd be nice for the two of us to share a secret..."

dialogues.jp: ぽそり、と呟くように付け足す。
dialogues.en: I muttered a little addition.
dialogues.text: I muttered a little addition.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「な、何でもないよ！！」
dialogues.en: "N, nothing!!"
dialogues.text: "N, nothing!!"

dialogues.jp:
照れくささを隠すために、そっぽを向いてベン
チから勢いよく立ち上がった。
dialogues.en:
Trying to hide my embarassment, I quickly stood up from the
bench.
dialogues.text:
Trying to hide my embarassment, I quickly stood up from the
bench.

dialogues.jp:
「ど、どうせ出てきたんだから……どっかで茶
　でも飲んでいこうぜ」
dialogues.en:
"S, since we're out here already... let's have a drink
somewhere."
dialogues.text:
"S, since we're out here already... let's have a drink
somewhere."

dialogues.jp: ほら、と手を差し出す。
dialogues.en: I held out my head to her.
dialogues.text: I held out my head to her.

dialogues.speaker: Kanae
dialogues.jp: 「うん、……そうだね」
dialogues.en: "Yes... that sounds good."
dialogues.text: "Yes... that sounds good."

dialogues.jp:
すこしの｛ちゅうちょ／躊躇｝ののち、工藤は笑って俺の手をと
り、立ち上がった。
dialogues.en:
A little hesitant at first, Kudou then smiled and held my
hand while getting up from the bench.
dialogues.text:
A little hesitant at first, Kudou then smiled and held my
hand while getting up from the bench.

dialogues.jp: 白くて冷たいその手、離れるのが名残惜しい。
dialogues.en: I regretfully released her snow-white, cold palm.
dialogues.text: I regretfully released her snow-white, cold palm.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、今回は俺が誘ったんだからちゃんと｛おご／奢｝ら
　せていただく」
dialogues.en: "Ah, since it was my invitation, I'd treat you this time."
dialogues.text: "Ah, since it was my invitation, I'd treat you this time."

dialogues.speaker: Kanae
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふっ」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe."
dialogues.text: "Hehehe."

dialogues.jp:
そう付け足すと、工藤は楽しそうに笑い声をた
てた。
dialogues.en: Kudou giggled at my afterthought.
dialogues.text: Kudou giggled at my afterthought.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は並んで歩きながら商店街の喫茶店を目指
した。
dialogues.en:
We walked together to a coffeeshop at the nearby shopping
district.
dialogues.text:
We walked together to a coffeeshop at the nearby shopping
district.

dialogues.jp: そうして俺はしばらくぶりに……。
dialogues.en: And we then just whiled the time away...
dialogues.text: And we then just whiled the time away...

dialogues.jp:
本当にしばらくぶりに、満ち足りた休日を過ご
したのだった。
dialogues.en:
Yet, it was some of the most satisfying time I had ever
spent.
dialogues.text:
Yet, it was some of the most satisfying time I had ever
spent.

dialogues.jp: ◆葉桜の精◆
dialogues.en: ◆Cherry Tree Spirit◆
dialogues.text: ◆Cherry Tree Spirit◆

dialogues.jp: 工藤との約束の場所、
dialogues.en: At the place where Kudou and I promised to meet,
dialogues.text: At the place where Kudou and I promised to meet,

dialogues.jp:
俺の前に現れたのは和装の美少女、工藤叶だっ
た。
dialogues.en:
In front of me, was the pretty kimono-clad girl, Kudou
Kanae.
dialogues.text:
In front of me, was the pretty kimono-clad girl, Kudou
Kanae.

dialogues.jp:
工藤の男装の理由は、当主である祖母の言いつ
けによるものらしい。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's reason for pretending to be a guy was because of the
order's of the head of her family.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's reason for pretending to be a guy was because of the
order's of the head of her family.

dialogues.jp:
そして、もし女であることがばれてしまったら、
直ちに転校しなければならないという。
dialogues.en:
And if it were to be revealed that she was a girl, she would
immediately be transferred.
dialogues.text:
And if it were to be revealed that she was a girl, she would
immediately be transferred.

dialogues.jp:
秘密を守ること、秘密を守る手伝いをすること
を約束した俺は、本当にしばらくぶりに、満ち
足りた休日を過ごしたのだった。
dialogues.en:
Promising to keep her secret, and prevent others from
learning her secret, we spent the rest of the day idly, yet
happily.
dialogues.text:
Promising to keep her secret, and prevent others from
learning her secret, we spent the rest of the day idly, yet
happily.
